tagline: WZFO取景器相机，1965 年发布
description: WZFO于1965年推出的取景器相机。配备fixed, achromatic (two elements in one group), 75 mm 1:8。快门速度two leaf everset shutter, 1/30 s, 1/60 s, 1/125 s and B shutter speeds。使用manual, with red window。two zone focusing from 2.5 m to infinity。

specs.英文简介: The Ami 2 is a toy viewfinder camera made of plastic and issued from 1965 to 1969 by the Polish firm Warszawskie Zakłady Fotooptyczne (WZFO).
